prompt:
Plan an internal audit: Scope: ISO 9001 clause 8.4 (Control of externally provided processes, products, and services) at a medical device company with 45 critical suppliers. The company had 3 supplier-related nonconformities in the last 6 months and one field safety corrective action traced to a supplier component.

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- scope (string): scope of the change or audit
- criteria (string): audit criteria and standards
- schedule (string): audit schedule and timeline

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"scope": "Audit the company's control of externally provided processes, products and services (ISO 9001:2015 clause 8.4) across the 45 critical suppliers, with particular focus on the three recent supplier-related nonconformities and the field safety corrective action traced to a supplier component. The audit will evaluate supplier selection, qualification, ongoing monitoring, performance metrics, risk management, traceability, and corrective action processes.", "criteria": "ISO 9001:2015 clause 8.4; ISO 13485:2016 clause 7.4 (Purchasing) and clause 8.4; 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation) subpart B (Design Controls) and subpart D (Purchasing Controls); internal procedures (SOP-001 Supplier Qualification, SOP-002 Supplier Monitoring, SOP-003 CAPA).", "schedule": "Phase 1: Planning (Week 1-2) – define audit scope, select sample of 10-15 critical suppliers, prepare audit checklist.
